{{Quote|Name's Aza. Or Private Gundo, if you prefer. On guard for House Organa with the rest of the Republic.|translated=1|Gundo introduces himself|<ref name="TORFA" />}}
'''Aza Gundo''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] as a guard for the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]], where he learned that the [[House of Thul]], a rival house to Organa, was [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[CryoBan/Legends|CryoBan]] weapons onto the planet. He then asked a Republic-aligned individual to find and destroy the weapons, which the individual accomplished.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Got word House Thul is smuggling in CryoBan weapons. Very illegal. Freeze you in three seconds flat.|translated=1|Gundo explains the CryoBan situation|<ref name="TORFA" />}}
Prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Aza Gundo ran with a group of individuals who were involved in illegitimate activities. However, he eventually made a decision to change the direction his life was headed and joined the [[Republic Army]], which took part in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, in the year 3643 BBY the Kel Dor held the rank of [[Private/Legends|private]] in the army and had been stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] as a [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] for the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]] aligned with the Republic.

[[File:Deforested_Slopes.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A dirt path runs through a grassy field dotted with pine trees and snow with mountains visible in the distance.|Aza Gundo spent time in the Deforested Slopes on Alderaan.]]
While stationed as a guard, Gundo learned through his old contacts that the [[House of Thul]], a rival house to House Organa in the [[Alderaan Civil War]], were [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] illegal [[CryoBan/Legends|CryoBan]] weapons, including [[CryoBan rifle/Legends|rifles]] and [[CryoBan cell|cells]], onto the planet to use in the conflict. The Republic forces managed to put a halt to the [[CryoBan smuggling ring|smuggling ring]] bringing in the weapons, but not before a large amount had already made their way into Thul hands and were being used with devastating effect on Organa and Republic forces.<ref name="TORFA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the smuggling ring was squashed, Gundo asked an individual aligned with the Republic, whom he met in the area known as the [[Deforested Slopes]], to help him with the CryoBan problem, tasking the individual with destroying the weapons that Thul troops were carrying. The individual agreed and traveled to the area of the [[Apalis Coast]] known as the [[Organa Vinerium]], where the individual located and [[Death/Legends|killed]] a large number of Thul troops, taking and destroying CryoBan rifles,<ref name="TORFA" /> cryo cells, and a [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] controlled by House Thul. Upon the individual's return to Gundo, the private congratulated and rewarded the individual with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and equipment.<ref name="TORRSC">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Revenge Served Cold|Alderaan}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Used to run with a bad crowd. But I'm trying to go legit, with the Republic, you follow?|translated=1|Gundo about his past|<ref name="TORFA" />}}
Aza Gundo was a male Kel Dor with [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin. He ran with a group of individuals early in his life who he would later come to consider bad company, but eventually decided to try and turn over a new leaf and joined the Republic to help in the Cold War. During the war, though, he chose to use information gained through his old connections to help the Republic and House Organa war effort.<ref name="TORFA" />

==Equipment==
While stationed as a guard Gundo wore white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="TORFA" /> Due to Alderaan's atmosphere Gundo had to wear an [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|Antiox breath mask]]<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> while on the planet.<ref name="TORFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Long as you don't come back in a block of ice, I'll be impressed.|translated=1|Gundo's response if the player accepts the quest.|<ref name="TORFA" />}}
Aza Gundo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game, Gundo gave the "Frozen Assets" quest to players of the Republic faction on the planet Alderaan. The quest is optional, but this article assumes players complete it<ref name="TORFA" /> as well as the bonus quest "Revenge Served Cold" in order to achieve 100% game completion.<ref name="TORRSC" /> The equipment rewarded to the player depends on the class they play.
